general_notes: Candidates fall into recurring groups per state: (1) target in a dark frame border (near-perfect); (2) blurred copy of the target; (3) dark app presentation, scaled down on black with a vignette (character faithful, painted backdrop lost); (4) tight zoomed crop in a dark vignette (limbs and feet cut off); (5) light-background presentation (washed flames, head-edge/rim artefacts, extra blob in depleted); (6) a different smooth 3D render. Within-group candidates looked identical to me and were scored identically; tiny pixel-level differences may exist that I could not resolve at this size. The depleted target itself contains a grey rectangle near the feet that the framed candidate keeps. Scoring the framed candidates at 8.5 on P3/P4 reflects only the added border; if the border is counted as neutral app chrome they would merit about 9.5.
